title: Appeals and Grievances: Running Amount in Dispute on a Late-Filing Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select Claim
content:
## Appeals and Grievances — running amount in dispute on a Claim Factual Reconsideration as late-filed TRICARE Select lines join it

**1. The amount recorded.** The amount in dispute recorded for a further late-filed line joining an open reconsideration is the amount the case carries once the line has joined it: the amount the case already carries plus the payment at issue on the joining line, rounded to the cent.

**2. Which case, which amount, which line.** The case a posting joins is the patient's Claim Factual Reconsideration most recently filed among those still filed, or, where none is still filed, the one most recently filed among those under review. The amount that case already carries is the largest amount in dispute recorded on its records on the claim — the Claim Factual Reconsideration records on that claim number with status filed or under review — since each joining record carries the running total. The joining line is the claim's highest-numbered posting carrying the case line's denial, read from the TRICARE Select claim postings of that claim.

**3. The payment at issue on the joining line.** It is the TRICARE payment the joining line would have carried had it been paid, and no beneficiary liability is at issue on a line denied for the provider's late filing. The allowed amount at issue on the joining line is the amount the provider billed on it, divided for a nonparticipating provider by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit, rounded to the cent. The cost share on the joining line is the network outpatient cost-share percentage of the tier the joining line was billed under applied to the allowed amount at issue, or, under a tier that charges fixed network copayments and on a network line other than preventive care, that tier's network copayment for the service class, never more than the amount the cost share is figured on; the payment at issue is the allowed amount at issue less that cost share; each amount is rounded to the cent. The tier is the tier of the TRICARE Select enrollment the joining line was billed under, and its figures are those of the TRICARE Select schedule.

**Running total worked through (hypothetical)**

| Record on the claim | Payment at issue on the line | Amount in dispute recorded |
|---|---|---|
| case opened on line 2 | 200.00 | 200.00 |
| line 3 joins | 144.00 (billed 180.00 by a network provider, 20 percent cost share 36.00) | 200.00 plus 144.00, which is 344.00 |
| line 4 joins | 96.50 | largest recorded so far 344.00, plus 96.50, which is 440.50 |
